baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative at word 1 is followed by the reader's Rabb at word 2 and the superlative al-akram at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Recitation is commissioned by an authoritative possessor whose unsurpassed generosity supplies both warrant and capacity, so the utterance is relational rather than self-originating.

activation_trace.role: Reading and recitation supply the direct imperative act and function as an authorized vocal response.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the source to whom the commanded act remains answerable.
Praiseworthy nobility and generosity make authority enabling and giving rather than merely coercive.

changed_reading.before: A bare command to read followed by a separate praise of the Lord.
changed_reading.after: Recite as an authorized response to the Lord whose unsurpassed generosity makes the response possible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same three focus words can align collection in iqra, staged completion in Rabb, and abundant growth in al-akram.
baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative initiates collection of dispersed material; lordly care develops and completes what is collected; generous fertility makes the result more than a mere heap.

activation_trace.role: Collecting and joining supply the assembly operation performed by the imperative.
Repair, nurture, and completion turn collected pieces into a progressively formed whole.
Good growth and rain-bearing bounty supply the productive surplus by which the formed whole becomes fruitful.

changed_reading.after: Gather what is dispersed and let the cultivating Lord bring the assembled material to abundant fruition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Iqra at word 1 carries branches of appointed timing and patterned course, while Rabb and al-akram can support duration and ripening.
baseline_models.mechanism: Reading can be carried as a recurring, timed discipline: an appointed occasion opens a patterned course, sustained lordly presence keeps it from dissipating, and generosity is its ripening power.

activation_trace.role: An appointed time arriving or being delayed supplies a season for the commanded act.
Manner, pattern, and directed course turn the act from an instant into a repeatable way.
Staying, clinging, and lasting supply the continuity that holds the practice in place.
Fertile growth supplies the outcome of a practice allowed to mature over time.

changed_reading.before: Perform one immediate act of reading.
changed_reading.after: Enter the appointed, patterned practice whose continuity under the Lord permits generous ripening.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A reader-devotee branch of iqra joins the knowledge-forming branch of Rabb and the character excellence of al-akram.
baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative is performative formation: repeated reading makes a learned devotee, lordly care cultivates knowledge and self, and generosity names the noble character produced.

activation_trace.role: The devout or learned reader supplies an identity that the imperative can begin to form.
Knowledge formed through lordly care supplies the process by which both learning and the learner are cultivated.
Noble character and generosity supply the human quality toward which the reader is formed.

changed_reading.before: The addressee is told only to execute a reading.
changed_reading.after: Read so as to become a learned devotee cultivated into noble generosity by the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated command is placed beside naming, measured creation, human perception, and attached substrate. The gathering baseline therefore becomes an epistemic assembly of created signs: reading collects relations already impressed in embodied creation into a nameable, intelligible whole.

activation_trace.role: Collecting and joining anchor the changed reading in the focus imperative as an assembly operation.
The repeated collecting command establishes assembly as a frame that precedes the focus occurrence.
Name as indication gives the collected material a signifying handle and makes assembly intelligible.
Measuring and proportioning supply an already ordered created field for reading to gather.
Perceiving by sight, hearing, or sensation makes the human the receiver who detects the signs.
Attachment and adherence supply relational material whose connections, not isolated units, are gathered.

structural_cues: 96:1 repeats the focus imperative before naming, lordship, and creation.
96:2 compresses the human origin into emergence from attached material.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition, indication, measurement, perception, and attachment; I supply the arrow that reading assembles those created relations into an intelligible sign-complex. A live alternative is that creation only grounds the speaker's authority and does not alter the operation of iqra.

changed_reading.before: Gather unspecified items under cultivating care.
changed_reading.after: Gather the measured and attached signs of created reality into a nameable form that a human can perceive.

context_deltas.mechanism: A distinguishing mark guides recognition, while the pen is produced by cutting and smoothing a hard reed. Reading becomes the inverse completion of inscription: differentiated marks are gathered and voiced as disclosed knowledge, making al-akram specifically pedagogical generosity.

activation_trace.role: Gathering supplies the operation by which separate marks are combined into a readable whole.
Reading and reciting convert the gathered marks into articulated knowledge.
A distinguishing trace that guides to its object makes inscription function as evidence rather than decoration.
Cutting and paring a hard thing smooth supplies the material differentiation that produces a writing tool.
The pared writing reed supplies the instrument whose separated marks reading recombines.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the transition from unrecognized marks to knowledge.

structural_cues: 96:4 places teaching in an instrumental construction with the pen.
96:5 repeats the teaching root around the human's prior non-knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mark, cutting, writing instrument, and disclosure; I infer a production chain from carved distinction to gathered articulation. The live alternative is the simpler instrumental reading in which the pen records teaching but does not redefine iqra as recomposition.

changed_reading.before: Recite or gather in a general sense.
changed_reading.after: Recompose deliberately differentiated marks into voiced knowledge, receiving teaching as a concrete form of the Most Generous one's giving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The praise of maximal generosity acquires a dangerous reception-path: received abundance can be seen as self-sufficiency, swell into flood-like excess, and sever attribution to its source. Return to Rabb reverses that error, so iqra is also a discipline of receiving without claiming autonomous possession.

activation_trace.role: Generosity supplies the abundance whose reception can remain grateful or be misappropriated as self-sufficiency.
Rising, sweeping water supplies the material model for abundance crossing its proper boundary.
Seeing supplies the self-assessment through which received capacity is misread as autonomous.
Independence and self-sufficiency name the false conclusion drawn from abundance.
The split-root image of increase and rising exposes growth itself as the point where gift can be mistaken for self-production.
Return and restoration redirect accumulated capacity to the relation from which it came.

structural_cues: 96:6-7 gives self-perceived sufficiency as the occasion for transgression.
96:8 immediately counters that movement with emphatic return to Rabb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies generosity, overflow, self-seeing, sufficiency, increase, and return; I infer the causal path gift to false ownership to excess, with return repairing attribution. A live alternative is a simple contrast between divine generosity and an independently arrogant human, without generosity occasioning the trial.

changed_reading.before: The Most Generous is an uncomplicated assurance attached to reading.
changed_reading.after: Read as a recipient who keeps abundance attributable and returnable, because generosity misread as self-sufficiency can overflow into transgression.

context_deltas.mechanism: The commanded utterance enters a field of attempted prohibition, humble service, prayer, gentle guidance, binding instruction, and protection. Reading is no longer private decoding: it is embodied guidance whose generous authorization remains operative under human obstruction.

activation_trace.role: Recitation anchors the contested act as voiced communication rather than an abstract theme.
Lordly authority supplies the higher authorization against which the attempted prohibition is measured.
Restraint and forbidding supply the social force trying to interrupt the authorized act.
Humble worship and obedience identify the reader's embodied allegiance.
The specific worship practice makes the contested recitation bodily and recurrent.
Gentle indication toward the way and truth supplies the directional content of the voiced act.
Request and binding command show that the guided servant's speech can direct others rather than remain inward.
Ward against harm supplies the protective purpose of the guidance being commanded.

structural_cues: 96:9-10 places a prohibiting agent over a servant precisely when the servant prays.
96:11-12 tests the same servant as situated on guidance or commanding protective awareness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibition, service, prayer, guidance, command, and protection; I infer that these are dimensions of the communicative trajectory begun by iqra. The live alternative is that prayer and moral command are later actions adjacent to recitation but do not retroactively thicken its meaning.

changed_reading.before: Recite under benevolent authority in an uncontested setting.
changed_reading.after: Voice and embody protective guidance under the Most Generous one's authority even when another authority tries to stop the act.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated demands to inspect a case turn the addressee into a witness; denial and turning away attempt to escape that legibility, but divine seeing reverses the visual relation. Iqra thus oscillates between reading the scene and discovering that reader, speaker, and resister are themselves readable.

activation_trace.role: Reading supplies the focus operation that expands from voiced text to an inspectable moral case.
The attention-directing inquiry recruits the reader as an active examiner of what follows.
Contradiction of truth supplies the failed reading made by the resisting agent.
Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the attempted escape from evidence and address.
Disclosure to the knower frames the agent's fault as a refusal of available recognition.
The worshipped one supplies the transcendent subject of the final act of seeing.
Sight and insight reverse the gaze by making the would-be observer an observed object.

structural_cues: The attention formula recurs at 96:9, 96:11, and 96:13.
96:14 closes the sequence by shifting from what the addressee sees to the fact that God sees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated inquiry, denial, withdrawal, knowledge, and the reversed final gaze; I infer that iqra extends to reading a moral scene while being read within it. A live alternative is that the questions are only argumentative prompts and leave the lexical scope of iqra unchanged.

changed_reading.before: The reader stands outside an object and decodes it.
changed_reading.after: Read the moral scene as a recruited witness while recognizing that the reader and the resistant subject are simultaneously visible within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The gathering branch of iqra enters a contest between public summons. One side calls its council and relies on grasping, impact, and exclusion; the answering summons calls a repelling force. Reading can therefore constitute a public under generous lordship rather than merely transmit content to isolated hearers.

activation_trace.role: Gathering anchors the focus command as an act capable of assembling people as well as words.
Lordly authority supplies the allegiance around which the alternative public is gathered.
Generous nobility distinguishes this assembly's organizing principle from coercive prestige.
Seizing by the forelock supplies direct coercive control over the rival agent.
The forelock and taking hold of it locate social contest in the vulnerable leading part of a body.
Calling aloud supplies the performative act by which the resisting side tries to mobilize support.
The council as a gathered group supplies the rival social body activated by the call.
The answering call mirrors and overtakes the first summons at the same performative level.
Pushing, impact, and prevention supply the counterforce that breaks the rival council's coercive claim.

structural_cues: 96:17 and 96:18 form a mirrored pair of calls with opposed subjects and summoned groups.
The paired summons follows the threat of bodily seizure at 96:15-16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, two calls, a council, seizure, and repelling force; I infer that recitation gathers a counter-public whose allegiance challenges the prohibiter's social power. A live alternative is a purely forensic threat-response scene with no public-forming implication for iqra.

changed_reading.before: Gather words or recite to unspecified hearers.
changed_reading.after: Recite as a public-forming summons under generous lordship, able to withstand a coercive council and its rival claim to authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final imperatives provide a bodily vector for the patterned-practice baseline: refuse alignment with the obstructing agent, lower the body, and move into proximity. Reading is the opening movement of a durable discipline whose endpoint is nearness, not information possession.

activation_trace.role: Pattern and directed course anchor the focus command as the beginning of a trajectory.
The devout reader supplies the kind of person formed by continuing along that trajectory.
Obedient alignment, here negated toward the obstructing agent, supplies the first relational turn.
Lowering and humility give the reading-course a bodily posture opposite to self-sufficient elevation.
Nearness supplies the trajectory's endpoint and measures success by relation rather than accumulation.
Approach through an offering to God adds a giving-back movement to the endpoint of nearness.

structural_cues: 96:19 coordinates a negated obedience with two positive imperatives.
The sequence moves relationally away from the prohibiter, physically downward, and then toward proximity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-obedience, lowering, and approach; I infer that this ordered bodily sequence completes the course initiated by iqra. A live alternative is that the final commands are consequences of reading rather than part of its activated mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Follow a recurring reading practice that matures over time.
changed_reading.after: Begin with reading and continue through refused coercion, bodily humility, and an approach whose end is nearness to the generous Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates reproductive and birth-adjacent branches beneath a morphologically ordinary reading imperative. It remains anchored through the focus branches of enclosing pregnancy, nurture, and fertile bounty, sharpened by attached gestation and approaching birth in the context. Render it only as a contained metaphor for carrying meaning toward formation, never as a replacement lexical translation of iqra.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Iqra at focus word 1 has a womb-enclosing branch, Rabb at word 2 has staged nurture, and al-akram at word 3 has fertile growth.

activation_trace.role: A womb enclosing a pregnancy supplies the image of reading as carrying gathered meaning before manifestation.
Nurture and progressive completion supply the developmental process that brings what is carried toward form.
Fertility and abundant growth supply the ripening outcome of the gestational analogy.
Pregnancy fixed in the womb activates the latent enclosing branch already present in the focus root.
Approaching birth supplies a terminal image of carried potential nearing emergence.

changed_reading.before: Read content that is already complete and externally available.
changed_reading.after: Carry gathered meaning under lordly nurture until it ripens toward emergence, as a gestational metaphor for reading.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because water collection, cloud, rain, flood, returning water, and a water vessel form a cross-domain circuit around a verbal command. It remains anchored in branches of all three focus roots and gains ordered support from later context roots. Render it as a material analogy for circulation of received abundance, with explicit qualification that it is not a lexical gloss of the focus ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus can align gathering in iqra, cloud or collected water in Rabb, and rain-bearing fertility in al-akram.

activation_trace.role: Gathering, including water gathered in a vessel, supplies the collection phase of the circuit.
Low layered cloud supplies the suspended reservoir from which generous provision descends.
Abundant collected water reinforces Rabb as the holding source within the material analogy.
Rain-bearing bounty and fertile growth supply beneficial release and its living yield.
Flood-like rising force supplies the circuit's failure mode when abundance exceeds its bounds.
Returning rainwater supplies recirculation rather than terminal possession.
A water vessel supplies a final containment image that answers both dispersal and destructive overflow.

changed_reading.before: Reading receives and transmits abstract content.
changed_reading.after: Reading participates analogically in gathering, releasing, and returning provision, where generous flow must be held without becoming flood.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because greeting, covenant, recompense-seeking gift, returned speech, council generosity, and offering create a reciprocal economy under a superlative of generosity. It remains anchored in branches of every focus root and in a later sequence of return and approach. Render it as an asymmetrical response structure in which the reader gives back what was first given, not as a commercial bargain with the Lord.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus branches permit iqra as conveyed greeting, Rabb as binding covenant, and al-akram as a gift that elicits return.

activation_trace.role: A greeting conveyed through reading or saying supplies an address meant to pass between parties.
A covenant or binding pact supplies the durable relation within which address and response circulate.
A gift offered with return in view supplies the risky reciprocal image, subordinated here to prior divine generosity.
Returning an answer or speech activates recitation as a response rather than self-generated possession.
Generosity and giving within the council-root adds a social gift economy that can rival or echo the focus generosity.
Approach by offering to God supplies the final giving-back movement without equalizing giver and recipient.

changed_reading.before: The Lord gives the command and the reader simply complies.
changed_reading.after: The Most Generous first gives address and capacity; recitation returns that gift as greeting, pledged response, and approach.

strongest_changes: The pen and knowledge cues make reading the recomposition of deliberately differentiated marks into disclosed knowledge.
Transgression, self-sufficiency, and return turn divine generosity into a test of attribution: received abundance must not be mistaken for autonomous possession.
Prohibition, prayer, guidance, and protection make recitation an embodied and contested act rather than private decoding.
The final non-obedience, prostration, and approach give the reading command a bodily course whose endpoint is nearness.
The paired public summons activate gathering as the constitution of a counter-public under generous lordship.
summary.what_was_special: The focus remained multiply live: ordinary recitation coexisted with assembly, disciplined formation, and timed pattern, while context activated inscription, contested authority, reciprocal visibility, public gathering, and bodily approach. Fringe branches also formed contained gestational, hydrological, and gift-response models instead of being discarded for strangeness.
remaining_uncertainties: The assembly reading is well anchored in the root inventory, but how far it should modify the ordinary imperative rather than accompany it remains open.
The gift-to-self-sufficiency causal arrow is abductive; the context may instead present generosity and arrogance as a contrast without making the former an occasion for the latter.
The non-dominant increase-and-rising mapping for Rabb sharpens the overflow model but should not displace the dominant lordship mapping.
The final bodily sequence may retroactively define the course of reading, or it may be a distinct consequence of the earlier command.
The three outliers are coherent branch networks but require explicit metaphorical containment in any downstream prose.
